## `CreateJwtSPClientConfiguration`

**POST** `/v2/manage/custom-providers/jwt`

Create JWT SP configuration

Creates a new Service Provider (SP) configuration for a JWT client in the Tenant, defining details such as endpoints, mapping, and other required settings.

### Example

```c#
public static async Task CallCreateJwtSPClientConfiguration(LoginRadiusClient client) {
    CreateJwtSPClientConfigurationRequest createJwtSPClientConfigurationRequest = new CreateJwtSPClientConfigurationRequest("<appName>", "<mapping>", "<algo>"); //Required

    try {
        var response = await client.JWTCustomProviders.CreateJwtSPClientConfigurationAsync(createJwtSPClientConfigurationRequest);
        Console.WriteLine(response);
    } catch (Exception e) {
        var lr = LoginRadiusException.From(0, null, e);
        Console.Error.WriteLine(lr.Description);
    }
}
```

### Request body

`object` as `application/json`.

### Returns

`JwtSpConfig`

**DELETE** `/v2/manage/custom-providers/jwt/{jwtApp}`

## `UpdateJwtSPClientConfigurationByAppName`
